articles.title: New Technology Improves Renewable Energy Storage
articles.description: Scientists have developed a new battery system that can store renewable energy more efficiently.
key_points: The battery can store energy for longer periods.
It could help reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
The technology is still being tested before commercial use.
impact: Greater use of solar and wind power

articles.title: New Public Transport Plan Announced
articles.description: The city has announced a new plan to improve public transport and reduce traffic congestion.
key_points: More buses will be added during peak hours.
New bike lanes will be built across the city.
Ticket prices will remain unchanged for now.
impact: Less traffic in the city center

articles.title: Researchers Warn About Rising Sea Levels
articles.description: A new study suggests that coastal cities may need stronger protection against rising sea levels.
key_points: Sea levels are increasing faster in some regions.
Coastal areas may face more frequent flooding.
Experts recommend investing in stronger infrastructure.
